capabilities: Plays six memory and logic games in a window over the current note
Runs mixed sessions of roughly 1, 3 or 5 minutes
Adapts difficulty per game from recent attempt scores
Tracks daily points goals with optional in-app reminders
Charts a six-axis exercise profile and per-game history
extras: Public beta not submitted to the Obsidian Community Directory; installed manually from a GitHub release ZIP. Keeps only the latest 1,000 attempts and 365 daily aggregates. Native/mobile, touch and screen-reader acceptance are not claimed, and the difficulty and profile index have no user-study calibration.
intentEvidence: The plugin ID changes from casual-memory-games to brumalt.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to take short memory or logic exercise breaks without leaving the app.

relations.evidence: The plugin ID changes from casual-memory-games to brumalt.

summary: Offline plugin with six short memory and logic games, adaptive difficulty, daily point goals and local progress charts.
